description: Open a live session on one target of an e2e project: loads the config, starts the app command the target declares (if any), boots the engine (a browser, a simulator), opens the app (its URL, or the pinned app on a device), and returns the session id, the catalog of tools it can run, and the first observation. With test, it runs that one test first and stops on the screen where the test passed or failed, with the failure and its line ahead of the catalog. Several sessions can be open at once, one per agent, each with its own engine: pass the returned session id to every later call. Then act with call and look with call {tool: "observe"}.

config.description: Path to an e2e config file, relative to the server's directory; default: the nearest e2e.config.ts, .mts, .js, or .mjs

headed.description: Show the browser or simulator, when the engine supports it; pass true when the user wants to watch. Default: headless, unless the server was started with --headed

target.description: Target name from the config; required when the config declares several

test.description: One test to run in the session first, named the way npx e2e run takes it: tests/checkout.e2e.ts:12, where 12 is the line its test( call is on (not a failing line inside it), or a file or name that selects one test. The session then stays on the screen where the test stopped; afterEach hooks and fixture teardown run at close_session. To rerun after editing the test, close_session and open_session with test again

name: open_session
